cover.description: Optional cover image for the custom collection, stored as a blob in the actor's PDS. Renderable cover URLs are resolved from this reference at read time; it is not itself a transport URL.

title.description: Display title of the custom collection. Mutable, and duplicate titles across an actor's collections are allowed.

createdAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

updatedAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the custom collection.

main.description: A custom collection header owned by an actor. Items are separate social.dracome.library.collection.item records that reference this record by AT-URI. The rkey is a TID minted once at first create and never changes.
